SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as web_orders_placed
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'

SELECT 
  status,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY status

calls.statement:
SELECT 
  fulfilment_type,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY fulfilment_type
ORDER BY fulfilment_type

SELECT 
  COUNT(*) as total_orders,
  COUNT(order_ts_utc) as orders_with_timestamp,
  COUNT(CASE WHEN order_ts_utc IS NULL THEN 1 END) as null_timestamps
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'

SELECT 
  login_state,
  COUNT(*) as order_count
FROM fact_web_order
WHERE CAST(order_ts_utc AS DATE) = DATE '2025-11-28'
GROUP BY login_state
ORDER BY login_state
